newsitem.title: UK: Ship loses 20-30 containers off British coast.
newsitem.headline: Ship loses 20-30 containers off British coast.

text.p: Rescue services said on Friday they were trying to recover between 20 and 30 containers lost overboard from a cargo ship off Britain's southwest coast.
Coastguards said spotter aircraft would fly over the area to help a tug boat retrieve the containers, which were drifting east of the Singapore-registered Tokio Express.
Steve Olley at the Falmouth Coastguard station said no casualties had been reported among the ship's crew.
He said the ship was heading for the English port of Southampton where it would await the recovery of the containers -- believed to contain general cargo.
The Tokio Express left the Dutch port of Rotterdam on Thursday en route for Halifax in Nova Scotia, Canada.
